title: Events between services over Kafka
prompt: The services of this company exchange events over Apache Kafka. Create src/events-transport.ts with `export function eventsTransport(kafka: KafkaClient)` (KafkaClient from @browserlessapi/inferlo/kafka; the client is new KafkaJS.Kafka(...) from @confluentinc/kafka-javascript) that returns Inferlo's built-in Kafka event transport for this service, named "bench-app" like the app. Topics it creates need 6 partitions, and a failed delivery should be retried after 10 seconds. Do not write your own transport.
